name: Meshobab
title: Simeonite leader
summary: Meshobab was a leader from the tribe of Simeon mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was among the Simeonite chiefs who expanded their territory by driving out the original inhabitants. He is part of a genealogy showing the leaders of the tribe of Simeon during the time around King Hezekiah of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Meshobab is listed among the leaders of the tribe of Simeon in a genealogical record in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Simeonite Chiefs
keyEvents.description: Meshobab belonged to a group of named chiefs from the tribe of Simeon who held great influence and power within their clans.

keyEvents.title: Expansion of Territory
keyEvents.description: Meshobab and the other Simeonite leaders went to the entrance of Gedor to seek pasture for their small livestock, and found lush and good grazing lands.

keyEvents.title: Expulsion of the Hamites
keyEvents.description: The Simeonite chieftains, including Meshobab, defeated the original Hamitic inhabitants and settled in their place because there was pasture for their small livestock there.

keyEvents.title: Military expedition to Mount Seir
keyEvents.description: In the days of King Hezekiah, some of the Simeonites, possibly including Meshobab, went to Mount Seir and struck down the remaining Amalekites who had survived there.
